    await run(

           sync_status = 'synced', last_synced_at = ?, server_updated_at = ?

           damaged_count = ?, created_at = ?, updated_at = ?, sync_status = 'synced', last_synced_at = ?, server_updated_at = ?
       WHERE id = ?`,
      record.name,
      record.description ?? null,
      record.stock_count,
      record.rent_per_day,
      record.purchase_price_per_unit,
      categoryId,
      record.damaged_count,
      record.created_at,
      record.updated_at,
      syncedAt,
      record.updated_at,
      equipmentId
    );
  } else {
    const result = await run(
      `INSERT INTO equipment (
         name, description, stock_count, rent_per_day, purchase_price_per_unit, category_id, damaged_count,
         created_at, updated_at, sync_id, sync_status, last_synced_at, server_updated_at
       ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'synced', ?, ?)`,
      record.name,
      record.description ?? null,
      record.stock_count,
      record.rent_per_day,
      record.purchase_price_per_unit,
      categoryId,
      record.damaged_count,
      record.created_at,
      record.updated_at,
      record.sync_id,
      syncedAt,
      record.updated_at
    );
    equipmentId = Number(result.lastInsertRowId);
  }

if (existingId) {
    await run(
      `UPDATE maintenance_logs
       SET equipment_id = ?, action = ?, remark = ?, cost = ?, created_at = ?, updated_at = ?,
           sync_status = 'synced', last_synced_at = ?, server_updated_at = ?
       WHERE id = ?`,
      equipmentId,
      record.action,
      record.remark ?? null,
      record.cost ?? 0,
      record.created_at,
      record.updated_at,
      syncedAt,
      record.updated_at,
      existingId
    );
    return;
  }

if (existingId) {
    await run(
      `UPDATE inventory_transactions
       SET equipment_id = ?, transaction_type = ?, quantity = ?, unit_price = ?, total_cost = ?, previous_stock = ?,
           new_stock = ?, note = ?, created_at = ?, updated_at = ?, sync_status = 'synced',
           last_synced_at = ?, server_updated_at = ?
       WHERE id = ?`,
      equipmentId,
      record.transaction_type,
      record.quantity,
      record.unit_price,
      record.total_cost,
      record.previous_stock,
      record.new_stock,
      record.note ?? null,
      record.created_at,
      record.updated_at,
      syncedAt,
      record.updated_at,
      existingId
    );
    return;
  }

if (rentalId) {
    await run(
      `UPDATE rentals
       SET customer_id = ?, equipment_id = ?, expected_return_date = ?, quantity = ?, advance_amount = ?, remark = ?,
           rented_at = ?, returned_at = ?, total_price = ?, status = ?, discount_amount = ?, amount_paid_on_return = ?,
           amount_due = ?, return_revenue_amount = ?, payment_status = ?, updated_at = ?, sync_status = 'synced',
           last_synced_at = ?, server_updated_at = ?
       WHERE id = ?`,
      customerId,
      equipmentId,
      record.expected_return_date ?? null,
      record.quantity ?? 1,
      record.advance_amount ?? 0,
      record.remark ?? null,
      record.rented_at,
      record.returned_at ?? null,
      record.total_price,
      record.status,
      record.discount_amount ?? 0,
      record.amount_paid_on_return ?? 0,
      record.amount_due ?? 0,
      record.return_revenue_amount ?? 0,
      record.payment_status ?? "Pending",
      record.updated_at,
      syncedAt,
      record.updated_at,
      rentalId
    );
  } else {
    const result = await run(
      `INSERT INTO rentals (
         customer_id, equipment_id, expected_return_date, quantity, advance_amount, remark, rented_at, returned_at,
         total_price, status, discount_amount, amount_paid_on_return, amount_due, return_revenue_amount,

       ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'synced', ?, ?)`,

  }
